pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Combobox pattern (editable, list autocomplete, no automatic selection) with a multi-selectable listbox; selected values as a list of chips with remove buttons.

roles.role: list of listitems; each remove control is a native button

aria.value: true when the listbox is shown
id of the active option; removed when none
true for selected options; for Select all, when every enabled option shown is selected
true for disabled options and, once maxSelected is reached, unselected ones
Reflect invalid, required, description, and error text

keyboard.action: Opens and activates the first / last enabled option.
Moves the active option, skipping unavailable options, wrapping.
Moves the active option by 10 / to the first or last.
Toggles it (Select all toggles the options shown); the list stays open unless closeOnSelect.
Closes the listbox / clears the text.
Closes the listbox and moves focus (chip remove buttons are tab stops before the input).
Edits the text, opens, and filters (or loads).

focus: DOM focus stays on the input while choosing; options are never focused. Chip remove buttons take focus with Tab; after removing a value focus returns to the input.
notes: Selecting and removing values is announced ("{label} selected", "{label} removed") through the shared polite live region, as are result counts, loading errors, and reaching the maximum.
Selection is shown with a check mark and aria-selected, never by color alone.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
